newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wal-Mart rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wal-Mart rating raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch has named Wal-Mart Stores Inc as its Focus One stock of the week and raised its near-term rating to buy from accumulate, the brokerage firm said Wednesday.
-- Merrill analyst Daniel Barry, in an interview, reiterated his six- to 12-month price target range of $35 to $37, based on a multiple of 21 times his 1998 earnings estimate of $1.75 per share.
-- Merrill's estimate for 1997 remains $1.54 per share and the long-term rating remains buy.

-- Merrill quantitative analysis highlights Wal-Mart's attractiveness as an "early cycle cyclical," said Barry. Stocks of such companies have lagged the market for several months, making them relativley attractively priced, he said.
-- Shares of the Bentonville, Ark.-based discount retailer closed at 29-1/8 Tuesday.
